events.title: Mockingbird Wine Tasting Dinner with Rachel Nasatir
events.description: Join us for a special evening at The Mockingbird as we welcome Rachel Nasatir of Cutting Edge Selections for a guided wine tasting dinner. The night features a five-course Greek-inspired menu with wine pairings presented throughout the evening. Menu includes Whipped Feta Mezze, Horiatiki, slow-simmered Mavromatika Soup, Greek Sheet Pan Chicken and Vegetables, and Yiaourtoglyko. Reservations are required and seating is limited.
events.price: $75 per person | $150 per couple (includes tax and gratuity)

events.title: Mockingbird Jam 2026
events.description: Mockingbird Jam is our 2026 community fundraiser for ALS research and families dealing with ALS. Join us for yoga at 9 AM, church service at 10 AM, live music from 11 AM to 8 PM, food trucks, a silent auction, and all-day fundraising throughout the property.

events.title: Wine & Canvas: Sunset Toast
events.description: 🌅🎨🍷 Paint Sunset Toast on a rustic staggered wood pallet at The Mockingbird on Mill Road. This guided, beginner-friendly experience walks you step by step through a glowing coastal sunset with ocean waves, wine glasses, and tropical flair. No experience needed — just sip, relax, and create. Food, wine, flatbreads, and more available for purchase. $50 per guest.
events.image_alt: Wood pallet painting of a beach sunset with two wine glasses, ocean waves, and tropical flowers

events.title: Mother’s Day Floral Workshop with Meregold Creations
events.description: Join us at The Mockingbird for a special Mother’s Day floral workshop with Meredith of Meregold Creations. Create your own beautiful floral arrangement in a wine bottle with all supplies and instruction provided. No experience needed — just come ready to sip, create, and enjoy a relaxing afternoon. Doors open at 11 AM, crafting begins at 12 PM. Food and drinks will be available for purchase from The Mockingbird. $35 per person.
